## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The criterion hint should be fixed because following it produces criteria rejected by the supported `require_shall=True` option.

## Changes
The pull request revises criterion-writing and bullet-prefix hints and adds `review.txt`. Validator behavior and tests remain unchanged.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/criteria.py:1 — correctness — Make the criterion hint respect require_shall — With `require_shall=True`, following the new hint with `- Save the result` produces a rejected criterion. The hint says “without the word shall,” while the validator requires `" shall "` in this mode, as the existing tests confirm. — Users enabling the strict option receive instructions that prevent their criteria from passing validation.
